scope: Review of fifteen SAT refinement packets, with new exact subroutines and relative contraction certificates

claims.name: polynomial-space coefficient below 64
claims.limitation: Normalized tensor wires; ordinary proof and finite exact certificate, no proof-assistant formalization

claims.name: cached time coefficient below 38, space below 34
claims.limitation: Uses subexponential space; complete group-oracle, table-construction, and matrix costs are included

claims.name: exact cached balancing O(NQ^2) candidate scoring
claims.limitation: Rational-operation complexity and measured local code performance; shared preprocessing and bit costs still apply

claims.name: residual precision P minus guaranteed valuation
claims.limitation: Safe division and creation caps required; creator evaluators may retain their prior costs; no change to mode tuple count

claims.name: unchanged deformation, recovery, child identities, SAT reductions
claims.limitation: Not an independent verification of the full upstream ETH theorem or all archived claims

claims.name: smaller unrestricted SAT logarithmic order
claims.limitation: The earlier structured-summation and representation interfaces remain unconstructed

claims.name: end-to-end SAT performance improvement
claims.limitation: The delivered implementations are exact components, not a complete SAT solver

claims.name: global optimum over all prior parameter recombinations
claims.limitation: The comparisons include explicit strong compatible compositions, not a lower bound on all possible algorithms
